title: Primal Rage
overview:
A meteor strike has thrown the Earth back into a primitive age, and the reshaped world is now called Urth. Seven monstrous beasts awaken from deep beneath its crust and are worshiped as gods by the tribes of surviving humans. Some want to keep the peace, others want to plunge Urth into chaos, and they fight one another for control of the land.

Pick a prehistoric beast and battle one-on-one in this 2D fighting game, with creatures brought to life through stop-motion animation. Special moves are performed by holding buttons, entering a motion and releasing. Human worshipers wander into the arena, and you can devour them to win back health.

- Seven beasts, including Sauron, Talon, Vertigo, Blizzard, Chaos, Diablo and Armadon
- Arcade mode: conquer Urth territory by territory, with 16 difficulty settings
- Training mode and two-player versus with handicaps
- Extra two-player Tug of War and Endurance modes
